theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ → ∀ (K : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (B : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ K = n → ‖B‖ ≤ A → Real.sqrt ((((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • B).comp K.subtypeL).adjoint ∘L ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • B).comp K.subtypeL)).det) ≤ 1 + t * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (K.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ B.toLinearMap) + ε * |t|
